semantics.clock: All sequential updates on positive clk edges.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset has priority in every state, clears prefix, delay capture and counters, returns to searching; no power-up behavior promised before reset.
semantics.search: Consume one data bit per edge while searching for 1101, retaining overlapping prefix matches. Detection edge completes pattern; following four edges capture delay MSB first.
semantics.counting: Immediately after fourth delay capture edge E, counting=1 and count=delay. For post-edge indices E+k with 0 <= k < 1000*(delay+1), counting=1 and count=delay-floor(k/1000). At E+1000*(delay+1), counting=0 and done=1.
semantics.done: done=0 during search/capture/counting. After timeout done stays high until an edge in done state samples ack=1, then search resumes with empty prefix. Data on acknowledgment edge is not searched. Ack is ignored before done.
semantics.data_ignored: Ignore data during counting and done. Count is unconstrained when not counting.

numeric.remaining: Unsigned 4-bit countdown, decrement only when nonzero at 1000-cycle boundary.
numeric.subcounter: Unsigned 10-bit elapsed counter 0..999, resets each 1000 cycles; maximum timer duration 16000 cycles.
numeric.arithmetic: Exact integer timing, no rounding or saturation, no observable wraparound while counting.

verification.method: Independent public-port self-checking simulation with expected cycle formula rather than DUT internal state.
coverage: All 16 delays and each cycle of each countdown
Prefix overlap and misleading serial sequences
Data changes and ack during counting ignored
Done holds until acknowledgment and repeated transactions
Synchronous reset during search, capture, counting and done
verification.tools: Icarus v12, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top, finite compile and simulation timeouts; preserve logs.

specification_ambiguities: Count outside counting is explicitly dont-care; choose retained register value.
Search begins on the edge after acknowledgment; acknowledgment edge clears prior pattern history.
